data.one_liner: Official Spine runtime for Flutter to load, display, and interact with skeletal animations.
data.what_it_does: The spine-flutter runtime provides functionality to load, manipulate, and render Spine skeletal animation data. It supports desktop, mobile, and web targets based on the spine-c/spine-cpp runtime.
use_when: You need to render and interact with Spine skeletal animations in your Flutter application or game.
Your assets are exported from Spine 4.3.xx.
avoid_when: You require features not supported by spine-flutter, such as two-color tinting or screen blend mode.
You are using a different animation tool like Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Official runtime supporting all major Flutter deployment targets (desktop, mobile, web).
Comprehensive API coverage of all Spine runtime types via auto-generated code.
Supports loading Spine data from custom sources like memory, encrypted storage, or databases.
weaknesses: Users of your software must have their own Spine license unless you obtain specific licensing terms.
Does not support two-color tinting and screen blend mode.
data.setup_notes: Must initialize Spine Flutter in main() using await initSpineFlutter(), and follow platform setup instructions if building from native sources.
